text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that a compilation of the interview taken at the start of the year would be aired on TV,
I sat down to watch it with Inari One—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, when we asked Oi's promising
new star, Inari One, about her future
goals on the show, she gave a rather unexpected answer!”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Inari's next big goal is none other than!
The Japan Dirt Derby, ya hear!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "‘A Derby, yes, but of all things, the Japan Dirt Derby!? Is this effectively an announcement of moving to dirt racing! When pressed with further questions—’"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Babbling on and on ain't stylish.
Sorry, but if you wanna see what I'm about, just watch me run in the race!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Thus, no clear answer was given, leaving behind nothing but shock and mystery...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, this feels like a fish bone stuck in my throat!
Is it really that shocking for me to run at Ohi?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...These kinds of things too,
I really wanna change 'em.
choice_data_list: It can be changed, you know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, that's right! That's what the
Japan Dirt Derby and the Tokyo Daishoten are for!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "—And so, in order to ascertain Inari One's true motives, we paid a visit to Ohi, where she used to run before transferring to Tracen Academy!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gah!?
Oi... don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Could we ask you a few questions regarding
Inari One's announcement to run
in the Japan Dirt Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
""Huh? Inari's running
in the Japan Dirt Derby?""

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I-Isn't that the boss?!
Those reporters even went and interviewed the boss...?!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that true?
Inari declared that herself?"

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: "—Dammit all to hell! What in blazes does that Inari jerk think she's pullin'?!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"...Even he, who used to coach her,
questioned Inari One's methods—
no, he was outright furious...!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Just what is Inari One aiming for in the end!?
Our program will continue to watch over her with great expectations—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list: I have to explain the situation to the boss right away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she explains her ultimate goal and why she
needs to conquer regional races to get there,
the Master's anger will surely—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Gimme a break, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Gimme a break, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't you say a single word to the boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...Back then, the Boss told me to 'go pick some flashy fights in the Central,' which gave me the push to transfer."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
From the boss's perspective, I'm twisting his words and trying to crawl back to the regional circuit.
...It's only natural he'd be furious.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's why until I produce results...
I don't think I have the right to face the Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—And you know, Boss...
I respect everyone at Oi more than anyone else...
and I'd like to think I know their strength better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—And you know, Sis...
I respect everyone at Oi more than anyone else...
and I'd like to think I know their strength better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Which is precisely why there's no way in hell I could tell you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —...Taking reaching the "top" of the local circuits lightly, that is.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Lady Inari's next major goal is none other than
the Japan Dirt Derby, y'hear?!

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the "Japan Dirt Derby"!?
You mean THAT "Japan Dirt Derby"
at Oi Racecourse!?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: Does this mean her main battleground won't be the JRA?! Or perhaps a declaration that she's committing exclusively to dirt—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Babbling on ain't stylish.
Sorry, but you'll just have to watch
how I run in the race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Indeed, even in previous interviews, Inari One never explicitly stated she would 'take the top'..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My resolve to reach the "very top"
ain't somethin' I'm gonna blabber on about with words...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
With my running! With results!
I gotta prove myself through cold, hard achievements!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise—
it'd be downright disrespectful to the boss and everyone back in Oi.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about time for training.
Let's roll, Boss."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...It's about time for training.
Let's roll, Sis."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I understand Inari One's feelings.
Still, is this truly for the best?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite sensing a vague unease,
I couldn't find an answer for what I should do—
